name: SharePoint Admin
description: Manage SharePoint folder permissions via Microsoft Graph — grant and remove user access by email.

config_variables.name: SHP_ID_APP
config_variables.label: App Client ID
config_variables.placeholder: Enter Azure AD app client ID

config_variables.name: SHP_ID_APP_SECRET
config_variables.label: App Client Secret
config_variables.placeholder: Enter Azure AD app client secret

tools.name: list_folder_permissions
tools.documentation: List all users and groups with their permission roles on a SharePoint folder. Shows whether each permission is directly assigned or inherited.

tools.name: grant_folder_access
tools.documentation: Grant a user read or write access to a SharePoint folder by their email address.

tools.name: remove_folder_access
tools.documentation: Remove a user's access from a SharePoint folder by their email address.

tools.name: copy_folder_access
tools.documentation: Grant a user the same permissions on a SharePoint folder that another user already has. Reads the source user's roles and applies them to the target user.
